blocks.tamil_translation: O My servants, you cannot cause Me any harm. Nor can you bring Me any benefit. O My servants! Even if those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come, men and jinn, all of them, were to have the heart of the one man among you who has the most fear of Allah, that would not increase anything in My kingdom. O My servants! Even if those of you who have gone before and those who are yet to come, men and jinn, all of them, were to come to have the heart of one great sinner among you, that would not cause any decrease in My kingdom. O My servants! Even if your earlier ones and later ones, men and jinn, all of them, were to gather together on one great plain and ask Me (for all their needs), and I were to fulfil completely the need of every one of them, nothing would decrease from My treasury except as much as the water of the sea decreases when a needle is dipped into the sea and taken out. (Dipping a needle into the sea and taking it out will not cause any decrease in the amount of sea water. In the same way, even if Allah gives to everyone from His treasury, no decrease will occur.) O My servants! It is only your (good and bad) deeds that I keep counted for you, and then I will give you in full only the recompense of those deeds. So whoever gets the opportunity to do good, let him praise Allah. And whoever gets what is other than good (sin), let him blame only himself for it” (because the sin happened only because his own self prompted him).

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَي اْلاَشْعَرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَامَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ بِخَمْسِ كَلِمَاتٍ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ اللهَ لَايَنَامُ وَلَايَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَنَامَ، يَخْفِضُ
